messages:
Noah (AE): quick sync — CareWell Systems sent a POC orderform + MSA redline. They want split invoicing across CareWell US and CareWell UK, and mentioned reverse-charge VAT on UK side. Also attached a short security questionnaire and asked for SOC2/audit evidence. Need legal + finance to confirm signer lanes and whether we can accept a single consolidated invoice with multiple billing refs. cc @Lina (SalesOps)

Lina (SalesOps): can we get the exact legal entity names + billing addresses? Also confirm if they will supply two PO numbers or one consolidated PO with line mappings. DocuSign routing options?

Noah (AE): Entities: "CareWell, Inc." (US) and "CareWell UK Holdings Ltd" (GB). They said they'll try to provide two POs but might only provide a single PO referencing two billing refs. They noted "reverse-charge applies" for intercompany VAT. Uploaded docs now.

contracts-bot: New files uploaded: carewell_msa_redline_2026.pdf, carewell_orderform_poc_2026.pdf, carewell_sec_questionnaire.xlsx

Harper (Legal): looking. early flags: 1) EU/UK data transfer language — do they want UK Addendum + SCCs? 2) indemnity/cap language in MSA has customer redlines; need to scope risk. 3) DPA: ask them to provide subprocessors list to avoid endless back-and-forth. For signatures propose: MSA -> Customer GC ; Orderform -> Customer AP. If they only provide one PO, we can map ledger lines but finance must confirm.

Ben (Finance): reverse-charge is fine but we need PO mapping and billing address per entity for VAT reporting. For UK we must show VAT id and a reverse-charge reference on invoice. If they want consolidated invoice with split ledger lines, we can do that, but prefer two PDFs for bookkeeping. Net60 for POC ok but need controller sign-off for any exceptions. Currency? do they want GBP or USD for the UK entity?

Noah (AE): Customer prefers GBP for UK invoices, USD for US. Also asked if we can accept a single wire covering both invoices — they prefer a single payment instruction listing both invoices.

Harper (Legal): single wire okay if reconciled by finance with invoice refs. On transfers: ask if they require DPA to enumerate subprocessors; if so request list. For SCCs vs UK Addendum we'll propose standard UK Addendum + EU SCCs as applicable. Also note: they redlined SLA uptime from 99.9% to 99.95% which will need escalation.

Lina (SalesOps): DocuSign routing suggestion:
```
Envelope A (MSA): Sender -> Harper (Legal) -> CareWell GC
Envelope B-US (Orderform/PO): Sender -> Ben (Finance) -> CareWell AP-US
Envelope B-UK (Orderform/PO): Sender -> Ben (Finance) -> CareWell AP-UK
If single PO: create Envelope B-Consolidated with two billing refs and attach to Envelope A via reference id.
```

security-bot: SOC2 report requested. Upload link: https://s3.company-reports/soc2-2025.pdf (internal control summary). Also note: customer requested confirmation of KMS key rotation frequency (we rotate every 90 days for customer-managed keys; hosted keys rotate per policy).

Ben (Finance): will prepare invoice templates with reverse-charge wording and VAT fields. Need PO numbers and preferred payment method. If they do a single wire we need a clear remittance that lists both invoice numbers. Controller approval pending for net60 POC.

Noah (AE): action items: 1) ask customer to provide subprocessors list + confirm SCC/UK Addendum preference 2) request PO numbers (or confirm single PO with billing refs) 3) ask customer AP for preferred payment flow (single wire ok?) 4) flag SLA uptick to product/legal if they insist. I'll ping customer now and update once i hear back. thanks all :thumbsup:
